# Camera scanner dependency

Vendored `@zxing/browser` 0.1.5 UMD bundle from the npm release:
https://registry.npmjs.org/@zxing/browser/-/browser-0.1.5.tgz

Upstream source and browser API documentation:
https://github.com/zxing-js/browser

The bundle includes the ZXing JavaScript decoding library. Keep its upstream licenses alongside this file. It is served only from this installation; scanner images are not uploaded or sent to third parties.
